decisions.reason: As a related extension into sewer infrastructure that uses the firm's fabrication, coating and public-sector capabilities, it is likely to stay unless early sales clearly fall below aspiration levels.

Because public waste bins are relatively distant from the firm's core offer, any modest early shortfall versus aspirations would likely trigger a shift of resources back to closer businesses or other developments.
Ground sleeves fit the firm's existing metalworking skills, customers and quality routines, so boundedly rational management would usually keep this low-distance product while learning about demand.
Cast iron ground sleeves are close to the established business and can be supported with current production and sales channels, making continuation likely unless results disappoint sharply.
Steel ground sleeves are the most natural adjacent extension of the firm's current capabilities and customer base, so they are likely to remain on the market during the next year.
